Sri . Aslam Khan, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Srinivasa T, learned counsel for respondent No.2 respectively have filed the petition under Section 482 R/w Section 320(2) and 320(8) of Cr.PC seeking permission to compound the offence and also to quash the criminal proceedings pending in CC No.20675/2020 on the file of the learned XI Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mayohall, Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A and 506 R/w Section 34 of IPC and under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2. Petitioner Nos.1 and 2 and respondent No.2 are present before the Court and they are identified by their respective counsels.

The joint affidavit reads as under:

sentences.text:
We submit that, the petitioner No.1 and 2 have preferred this petition to quash the Charge sheet filed against the petitioners/accused no.2 and 3 in east zone women p.s.
in CC No.20675/2020 for the alleged offence punishable U/Sec 498A, 506 R/w Sec 34 of IPC and Sec 3 & 4 of D.P. Act on the file of the learned XI Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mayo Hall, Bengaluru City.
The respondent No.2 is wife of son of petitioners i/e Mr. Abdul Wajid.
2. We submit that the marriage between son of petitioners i/e Mr. Abdul Wajid with the respondent No.2 with solemnized on 14/06/2012 and Two daughters were born to them.

We submit that at the instance of elders and well- wishers the petitioners and respondent No. 2 have amicably settled all our differences, litigations and disputes and decided to live together with love and affection,
Accordingly, the son of petitioners i/e Mr Abdul Wajid and the respondent No.2 have decided to lead happy marital life with their children.
4. We submit that, the matter is purely private, personal and matrimonial in nature.

In order to facilitate the son of petitioners i/e Mr Abdul Wajid and the respondent No.2 to lead happy married life and move on in the life, it is just and necessary to quash the Charge Sheet filed against the petitioners/ accused No.2 & 3 in East Zone Women P.S in CC No.20675/2020 for the alleged offence punishable U/Sec 498A, 506 R/W See 34 of IPC and Sec 3 & 4 of D.P. Act by exercising the power under section 482 of the Criminal Procedure Code.
5. We submit that, in view of the settlement between the petitioners and the respondent No.2, the respondent No.2 has no objections to quash the Charge Sheet filed against the petitioners.

WHEREFORE, we the petitioners and the respondent No.2 most respectfully pray that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to quash the Charge Sheet filed against the petitioners/ accused No.2 & 3 in East Zone Women P.S in CC No.20675/2020 NC: 2024:KHC:45496 for the alleged offence punishable U/Sec 498A, 506 R/W Sec 34 of IPC and Sec 3 & 4 of D.P. Act on the file of the learned XI Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mayo hall, Bengaluru City, in the interest of justice and equity.

We do hereby verify and declare that what is stated in this affidavit is true and correct to the best of our knowledge, information and belief and information and to that effect we have signed this affidavit."

4. The joint memo filed by the parties reads as under:
JOINT MEMO IS FILED BY THE PETITIONER NO.1 AND 2 AND RESPONDENT NO.2 "We, 1. Mrs. Fouzia Saleem W/o. Mr. Mohammed Zakriya @ Saleem Aged about 53 years, 2.
